name: iac_import
description: CRITICAL: Call this tool to signal the final completion of the import config-generation task. Reports the status, a summary of actions taken, and the mapping of Terraform resource addresses to cloud resource IDs for the import execution step.

status.description: The final status of the config generation. `true` if HCL resource blocks were successfully created for the selected resources, `false` if the operation failed.

summary.description: A detailed, human-readable narrative of the operation: which files were created or modified, which resource blocks were added, the naming and placement rationale, and any issues encountered.

address.description: The Terraform resource address for the generated block (e.g. 'azurerm_storage_account.example', 'module.keyvault.azurerm_key_vault.main').

resource_id.description: The cloud provider's native resource ID to import (e.g. an Azure resource ID, AWS ARN, or GCP asset name).

imports.description: The mapping of each generated resource block to the cloud resource it represents. Each entry feeds directly into `terraform import <address> <resource_id>`.
